description: This file provides a concrete implementation of a repository source for project repositories, managing URL and branch mappings and caching, and interacting with a SQL database.

classes.name: source
classes.description: Struct representing a source repository with a database connection.

methods.name: getOrCreateURLBranchID
methods.description: Retrieves or creates an ID for a URL and branch, utilizing cache for optimization.

methods.name: getOrCreateURLBranchIDPersistence
methods.description: Handles persistent creation or retrieval of URL and branch IDs in the database.

methods.name: insertIgnoreError
methods.description: Inserts URL-branch mapping into the database, ignoring errors.

methods.name: getIDByURLBranch
methods.description: Fetches the ID associated with a URL and branch from the database.

methods.name: GetURLBranchByID
methods.description: Retrieves URL and branch given an ID, utilizing cache.

methods.name: getURLBranchByIDPersistence
methods.description: Database query to retrieve URL and branch from ID.

methods.name: DiffTargetToMapped
methods.description: Converts a DiffTarget to a MappedDiffTarget with resolved IDs.

methods.name: NewSourceRepository
methods.description: Initializes a new source repository instance with a database connection.
